statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAKE THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA SAFE AND BEAUTIFUL ACT OF 2025
statements.title: MAKE THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA SAFE AND BEAUTIFUL ACT OF 2025
sentences: The bill creates the bipartisan ``District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Commission,'' comprising federal law enforcement leaders from DHS, the FBI, ATF, the U.S. Marshals, and the U.S. Attorneys for D.C., Maryland, and Virginia.
This commission will work directly with D.C. officials to crack down on crime, enforce federal immigration law, and support the Metropolitan Police Department.
Mr. Speaker, I rise to support H.R. 5103.
As a proud cosponsor of H.R. 5103, I stand with Representative McGuire and my Republican colleagues to deliver on President Trump's vision for our Nation's capital.
I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 5103 today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA POLICING PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA POLICING PROTECTION ACT
sentences: As a matter of background, Mr. Speaker, in January 2023, the D.C. Council enacted the Comprehensive Policing and Justice Reform Amendment Act of 2022, the CPJRA Act, D.C. Law 24-345, among numerous other police-related policy matters, most of which we advised against in the Oversight and Government Reform Committee.

Mr. Speaker, included in those police-related policy matters in the act that they, indeed, passed in 2022 was subtitle S of the CPJRA, which imposed a host of restrictions on police pursuit of criminal suspects.

In doing so, the D.C. Council essentially made it illegal for police to pursue and apprehend criminals if they were fleeing in a vehicle by imposing a complex matrix of 14 factors that police officers have to consider for whether or not they would pursue a fleeing vehicle.
I speak from my own experience as a police officer.
Has it potentially been involved in a crime that requires police interaction in an effort to enforce and address that crime that took place?
There are a number of factors that a police officer has to figure, but it has to be an option that you can pursue that car.
There is no way a police officer can know that.
There are too many factors, which basically means D.C. has made it illegal for police to pursue a vehicle.

We are restoring the discretion of the professional law enforcement officer to make a decision in a fraction of a second or two based upon his policies and training and the totality of circumstances of whether or not he needs to pursue that vehicle.

The legislation repeals subtitle S of the Comprehensive Policing and Justice Reform Amendment Act of 2022 and replaces it with policies empowering police to make vehicular pursuit of a suspect fleeing in a motor vehicle if the officer or supervisor deems it necessary, that it is the most effective means of apprehension, and if it is without unreasonable risk to bystanders.

It restores legitimate discretion to the police officers who actually work the streets of D.C. Mr. Speaker, let me just diplomatically address a couple of the accusations here regarding the nature of my bill.

This is why the professional law enforcement officers across the country, including here in D.C., are incredibly well vetted and trained and equipped to make decisions in a matter of seconds or less to pursue criminals and to enforce the law.

What is more dangerous for every community, including our Nation's Capital, for which this body has a responsibility to stand, is failure to give discretion for enforcement of law to the very law enforcement professionals that you have trained and equipped and placed on the streets.
My bill stands on the side of the citizenry of D.C. in an effort to enforce the law by fully empowering the police officers of D.C. to engage criminal conduct and enforce the law.
I urge strong support of H.R. 5143.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PEOPLE ARE SICK AND TIRED (Under the Speaker's announced policy of January 3, 2025, Mr. Roy of Texas was recognized for 60 minutes as the designee of the majority l
statements.title: PEOPLE ARE SICK AND TIRED (Under the Speaker's announced policy of January 3, 2025, Mr. Roy of Texas was recognized for 60 minutes as the designee of the majority leader.) Mr. ROY. Madam Speaker, I...
sentences: Our sovereign border, Mr. Speaker, our southern border is 1,954 miles long.

That 1,954 miles of southern border on the American side of our border, the northern side of that border, is patrolled by some of the finest law enforcement professionals that the world has ever known.
It is absolutely within the reach of those law enforcement professionals to effectively enforce our laws on American territory and American soil to the north of that 1,954-mile sovereign border.
Mr. Speaker, the southern side of that sovereign border is 100 percent controlled by criminal cartels.

Mr. Speaker, if we have an American Government executive authority that determines by its policy it is not going to enforce the law with a certain vigor that is required, when on the other side of the sovereign border, there very well-funded, well-armed, and organized criminal cartels, we are effectively partnering with those cartels.
At our southern border, the criminal cartel traffic human beings and drugs into our country.

In 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024, the executive branch of our government--the prior President and Secretary of Homeland Security--effectively partnered with the criminal cartels to traffic human beings and drugs into the heart of our country.
In many cases, they themselves were victims of the lies that the former executive branch put forth into the entire cartel pipeline, deep into South American and through Central American.

Rather than a law enforcement professional body, they drew these illegals into our country where they were waived in by a Federal law enforcement body transformed into a reception and processing force.
It is the same 1,954 miles of border, the same personnel, the same roads, the same physical barriers, the same communications systems, and the same surveillance systems.
Restore the sovereignty of our border.

There is this notion that we can somehow enforce criminal law with social vagaries; this idea that somehow if we will just be very, very nice to the criminal element, they will just stop committing crimes upon the law-abiding of our country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: In 1956, the Army Corps of Engineers classified the project as an operation and management project to be maintained at 9-feet deep and 100-feet wide for a 17-mile stretch of a river that runs through a density of population and has never been maintained.

I believe the Corps of Engineers is not in compliance with Federal law nor are they in compliance with the will of this body nor are they performing according to the funding of this body, and I intend to do something about it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SPECIAL INTEREST ALIEN REPORTING ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SPECIAL INTEREST ALIEN REPORTING ACT OF 2025
sentences: These are suspicious-travel-pattern, illegal immigrants coming into our country.

The President needs this legislation to mitigate against the radical judges that will try to stop him from releasing through Congress to the American people the data from 2021, '22, '23, and '24 of what suspected illegal aliens came into our country that fit this category.
Now, across the country and in this body, most Americans know I am very plugged into law enforcement.
I get calls every day from these guys, boots on the ground across the country, including deep in Federal law enforcement, and they support this law.
Don't tell me that Federal law enforcement doesn't want to do this or it is bad for the country in some way.
We are going to bring this bill to the floor, and they are going to call for a recorded vote.
Mr. Speaker, I support this bill, and I urge my colleagues to support it also.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA FEDERAL IMMIGRATION COMPLIANCE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA FEDERAL IMMIGRATION COMPLIANCE ACT OF 2025
sentences: When we were under Democratic majority control in recent years, since I have been in Congress, the Democrats supported and did not oppose some policy and legislative decisions at the municipal level in our Nation's Capital that we knew would injure our Nation's Capital in the realm of law enforcement.
Republicans have majority control in the House, the Senate, and the White House, so of course we are going to respond to the threat that we face within our Nation's Capital toward law enforcement.
My colleague stated two or three times in his opening statement that the District of Columbia does not obstruct Federal law enforcement.

What he is not saying, Mr. Speaker, is that the District of Columbia does not comply with Federal immigration law enforcement warrant detainers, which is the safest, most widely accepted means by which a human being that is in the custody of one jurisdictional authority is transferred to another jurisdictional authority safely and within the parameters of the law for the benefit of the individual and the community.
D.C. doesn't do that for Federal immigration detainers.
They subject their communities to dangerous circumstances and law enforcement to absolutely unnecessary danger.
However, we are going to, by God, require that our Nation's Capital comply with our Nation's Federal law.
